summary: SPACSphere Acquisition Corp. (SPAC) filed an 8-K disclosing a Business Combination Agreement with Mobilewalla Holdco, Inc. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into Mobilewalla, making Mobilewalla a wholly-owned subsidiary of SPACSphere. The boards of both companies approved the transaction. Prior to closing, SPACSphere will convert its Class B shares into Class A shares and domesticate from the Cayman Islands to Delaware. No specific price per share or premium was stated. Advisors, break fee, and expected close date were not disclosed. The risk-arb angle is the typical SPAC timeline and potential shareholder redemptions.
